title.narrative: Kenya Refugee and Host Communities RSF

description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome of the initiative is the availability of lending to individuals and MSMEs in 14 underserved counties across Kenya, with a specific focus on refugees, host communities, and women. Beyond the Project, IFC envisions a broader positive market effect, foreseeing the potential to foster greater market inclusiveness through demonstration and replication by showcasing the commercial viability of lending to underserved individuals and MSME segments within refugee and host communities. The Project complements several ongoing World Bank Group ("WBG") efforts to increase private sector activity among refugee and host community regions in Kenya.

The proposed investment consists of an unfunded Risk Sharing Facility (RSF) to Equity Bank (Kenya) Limited (EBK or the Bank) for a maximum portfolio of up to US$20 million. IFC's maximum exposure will be up to 50% or US$10 million equivalent. The RSF will target individuals and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in 14 of the most fragile counties in Kenya.

name.narrative: EBK is headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. The proposed Project will target individuals and MSMEs in Turkana, Garissa, West Pokot, Marsabit, Samburu, Isiolo, Mandera, Wajir, Tana River, Lamu, Laikipia, Baringo, Elgeyo Marakwet, and Trans Nzoia .
